visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a denim jacket, blue jeans, and a navy baseball cap stands outdoors on a green lawn in front of a wooden-framed building. He holds a pair of blue jeans in both hands, unfolding them to show the front and back. The lighting is natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a boutique with wooden flooring and white arched walls. Racks of clothing and displays of shoes on a central table are visible. The man gestures toward the space. (3) Close-up shots of denim-themed decorations and accessories, including denim flowers in a frame and patchwork denim panels on a wall. (4) The man stands inside the shop, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. The background is filled with racks of denim jackets and vests. (5) Fast-cut montage of detailed shots: close-ups of denim textures, a woman sewing with a sewing machine (JUKI brand), and a hand using scissors to cut patterns on denim. (6) A photograph is displayed showing the man and two other individuals on a brightly lit stage holding a trophy. (7) Back in the shop, the man holds up various denim suits and jackets on hangers. A 'House of Story Wear' sign is partially visible. (8) The man runs into a lounge-like room with bookshelves, wooden tables, and blue chairs. He then sits at a desk, flipping through a large illustrated book. (9) The man walks out of a glass door toward an urban street. An aerial map overlay appears with red location markers. (10) Finally, the man stands outside the building again, pointing to a 'HOUSE OF STORY WEAR' gold sign on the wall, smiling and waving.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote 'House of Story Wear', a sustainable fashion boutique in Taipei's Dadaocheng district. It highlights the store's unique value proposition—recycling old denim into new garments—and its diverse offerings including clothing sales, rentals, and a multi-functional library space.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically visits and features the store, provides its name and location details, and gives a direct personal recommendation.
